retmod_cb.desc: BV16 closed-box for `retmod_cb` used in trans-f; opaque semantics. For this program, `retmod_cb(a,b)` models (a mod b) on 16-bit unsigned (bvurem).

gcd_cb.desc: BV16 closed-box for `gcd_cb` used in inv-f; opaque semantics. For this program, `gcd_cb(a,b)` models greatest common divisor for inputs a and b on 16-bit unsigned.
